supporting_evidence.quote: Sales increased 20% in Q2 2026, and 18% for the six months ended June 30, 2026 compared to the comparable prior year periods.

input.reasoning_summary: The claim states that Amazon's net sales for Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) grew by more than 15% year over year. Evidence E2 explicitly states "Sales increased 20% in Q2 2026" compared to the prior year period. The table in E2 also shows consolidated year-over-year percentage growth of 20% for Q2 2026. Since 20% > 15%, the claim is supported by the evidence.
